name: Himuro Mao
source:
Hobbies: Touring antique bookshops
Skills: Flattery
Weakness: Sports in general

A third-year student and the former student council president of the east tower before [url=/c40212]Honoka[/url] was elected for the position. She is one of the best ice magic users within the academy.

Mao doesn't let small things worry her and talks in a calm way. Due to her mysterious personality, it is often to hard to guess what she's thinking about. Underneath her mysterious outlook, she has a very friendly personality and takes care of her peers. Despite all this, she prefers using brute force when she's faced with a problem.
